desc: Derive a rigorous characterization of legal edges in terms of bipartite connected components and their color-class sizes.
Prove a game-theoretic invariant or strategy determining the winner despite component-merging choices.
Determine a closed-form parity formula for the winner and validate it on edge cases and the provided samples.
Design an \(O(N+M)\) algorithm to compute the required component statistics.
Produce the final Python implementation with fast input, safe integer handling, and output of `Aoki` or `Takahashi`.
